result: Desktop Mission Canvas binds a trusted History contribution renderer (renderer:history@v1/semantic:history) that renders only cursor-scoped canonical ProjectionLifecycleEvent rows for the exact Workstream, rejecting foreign or malformed stream events without local reconstruction. Orchestrator verified full Desktop suite and zero-error svelte-check.
implementation: Added CanonicalEventHistory.render as a pure seam to normalize and validate ProjectionLifecycleEvent candidates against exact Workstream authority and projection cursor/revision baselines.
Added CanonicalEventHistoryContribution.svelte to render canonical history rows in the trusted desktop contribution surface without inferring layout or deriving authority client-side.
Registered a history contribution renderer binding in DEFAULT_CONTRIBUTION_REGISTRY with renderer:history@v1 and semantic:history, using generated local component ownership.

Extended layout-renderer runtime coverage with history fixture projection and assertions for local, foreign, stale, malformed and missing-authority event handling through CanonicalEventHistory.render, and checked trusted history contribution rendering via the production MissionCanvasRenderer path.

negative_cases.foreign_event_scope: CanonicalEventHistory.render rejects events from a different workstream and does not emit rows for them.
negative_cases.event_cursor_stale: Events with cursor at or before projection.durable_event_cursor are rejected and do not appear in bounded rows.
negative_cases.projection_revision_stale: Events with projection revision behind the current projection baseline are rejected as projection_revision_stale.
negative_cases.invalid_event_cursor: Events with unparsable cursor values are rejected before row emission.
negative_cases.invalid_projection_authority: Calling CanonicalEventHistory.render without a valid WorkstreamAuthorityContext returns invalid_projection_authority and emits no rows.

acceptance: History output is derived from ProjectionLifecycleEvent stream data and projection cursor context only.
Foreign-scope events do not appear in the rendered history dataset.
Trusted registry resolution is enforced for history through renderer_binding_id/semantic_binding_id, with no client-local contribution synthesis.
No placeholder synthetic layout path was introduced beyond rendering an empty state for missing rows.
